uncertain.access: Within one tenant, a developer on the free Starter plan can create a custom app and get app_id/secret + user OAuth immediately (self-serve, but capped at 10,000 basic API calls/month). Serving many tenants needs a store app, which requires ISV verification and official listing review. Labelled approval_required; partner_gated is arguable because of the ISV-verification step.
uncertain.auth_methods: Besides user OAuth (user_access_token), apps authenticate with tenant_access_token/app_access_token minted from app_id+app_secret (app/bot identity). I mapped this to bot_token; 'other' or 'jwt_service_account' would be alternative readings.
uncertain.mcp: Official package @larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp is local (stdio, or self-hosted HTTP). I found no vendor-hosted remote MCP URL for Lark international; Feishu (China) may have one that I could not confirm.
uncertain.access_pricing: Lark pricing page (larksuite.com/en_us/plans) is JS-rendered and returned no text; the free Starter plan and its 10,000-call quota are confirmed from the developer billing doc instead.

notes: open.larksuite.com doc pages are a JS SPA; content was read via the site's own document_portal JSON endpoint (same doc paths, lang=en-US) and cited by the human doc URL. The official MCP tool list has ~1,300 tool rows, so the API is very broad. Lark also supports event delivery over a long-lived (WebSocket) connection, not counted in api_styles. Advanced APIs need a purchased quota on Basic/Pro/Enterprise plans. Official MCP repo last pushed 2025-08-14 and is still labelled Beta.
